title: Welcome Corridor: progressive checklist, spotlight sprites & empty-state treatments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a cohesive set of UI assets and annotated screenshots for the Console first-run experience called the "Welcome Corridor". Deliverables include: a progressive checklist component (svg + Lottie micro-interaction), four compact spotlight sprites (PNG/SVG + 100, 200, 400px exports), three empty-state visual treatments (illustration + microcopy variants), and a small library of annotated product screenshots that show where to find key routes (Models, Deployments, Billing). Work should align with the Console design system token set, adhere to accessibility contrast guidelines, and be lightweight for fast initial load. This ticket coordinates with ENG-8721 for the dev-ready component spec and PM-2890 for content prioritization. Outcomes: artpack (vectors + exports), Figma frames with developer annotations, exported PNGs for release notes, and sample Lottie JSON for the checklist completion flourish.
activity_log: 2026-03-10 — Ticket created by Asha; rough scope and deliverables outlined. Linked PM brief (PM-4123).
2026-03-11 — Kickoff with PM and Eng: agreed animations budget (<=300KB Lottie) and decided to stagger checklist items to reduce cognitive load. Action: produce three microcopy variants for A/B.
2026-03-12 — First pass sketches uploaded to Figma (figma.com/file/REDACTED/welcome-corridor). Liam added initial layout for spotlight sprite positions.

2026-03-13 — Design review with Nadia (UX Research): recommended swapping yellow accent for teal on low-contrast backgrounds and adding a second colorway for dark-mode tests. Result: update illustration palette and create 2x contrast-tested variants.
2026-03-14 — Developer feedback (ENG-8721): requested separate SVG layers for motion targets and a fallback PNG sequence; added to acceptance criteria. Preparing handoff package.
acceptance_criteria: All vector assets committed to Drive + Figma with named layers and developer notes
Lottie microinteraction for checklist <= 300KB and has PNG fallback sequence
Three empty-state art treatments exported in light and dark variants at 1x and 2x
Annotated product screenshots (Models, Deployments, Billing) exported as PNGs with numbered callouts and brief copy
Design tokens used (spacing, color, type) documented in handoff and matches console-2026.03 tokens
Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary CTAs in onboarding frames
design_notes: Primary visual motif: narrow corridor with subtle perspective to guide scan flow (left-to-right). Avoid overly literal door/metaphors.
Spotlight sprites must be compact (max 48x48 visual bbox) and readable at small sizes; use simplified silhouettes.
Checklist microinteraction: items should animate in sequence with easing (0.22, 1.0, 0.36, 1) and 60-80ms stagger per item.
Empty-state variants: 'Guided', 'Quickstart', 'Import' — each with distinct CTA prominence and copy tuned for self-serve vs. enterprise onramp.
Dark mode: invert highlights but keep a soft rim-light to preserve separation on low-contrast backgrounds.
Performance: avoid filter-heavy SVGs; prefer flattened masks where possible for faster rendering in embedded webviews.
